prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach, grab and check object properties. Move to designated area or call expert. Release and pack or scan for objects. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObjectToDesignatedArea    /> <Action ID = CallExpertTeam    /> <Action ID = MoveTowardsObject    /> <Action ID = ReleaseObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectForSecurityTags    /> <Action ID = PackObjectForTransport    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavierThan10kg    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectGoingToExplode    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInDesignatedArea    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectValuable    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectHeavierThan10kg? THEN
				DO TakeObjectToDesignatedArea
		END
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectGoingToExplode? THEN
				DO CallExpertTeam
		END
	END
